name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 deadline not confirmed. Biology's English minima exceed central guidance. Funding pages differ on five versus six years; confirm award duration.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall final
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated GSAS Biology policy; no calendar year assigned.

english.toefl: 97 iBT in Biology FAQ; central guidance 90 old/4.5 new
english.note: Biology FAQ sets IELTS 7.5 vs central generally advised 6.5; use higher program minimum. Degree taught in English can exempt; central rule requires degree earned before application, or qualifying current full-time study with two consecutive years completed before enrollment. Qualifying citizenship routes also exist; confirm documentation/program acceptance. No new-scale Biology-specific TOEFL minimum stated.

applicationFee.note: GSAS affiliation/service/recent Tufts-graduate waivers have conditions and require proof. Central page invites hardship applicants to contact Graduate Admissions without stating citizenship eligibility; international approval not confirmed. These are separate from GSBS waiver rules. Biology FAQ lists narrower categorical exceptions; confirm the applicability of any central hardship request to Biology.

documents: Transcripts from all institutions; unofficial copies for review
Personal statement,maximum five pages/2,500 words unless program prompt differs
requirements.note: Biology minimum GPA 3.0; extensive laboratory experience may warrant exception. GSAS generally asks three recommendations, with two for current Tufts/Tufts-certificate applicants; confirm portal requirement. Contact possible mentors encouraged, not a stated prerequisite; first-year rotations lead to research-focus selection. List one or two concentrations and prospective faculty. GRE not required; FAQ says provided scores may be considered, while central says scores reviewed only when required.

international.note: Biology FAQ explicitly welcomes international students with same financial package as US citizens.

funding.note: Admissions-and-aid page guarantees admitted PhD students full tuition, competitive stipend and health coverage for six years through TA/RA support. FAQ separately says full-time students in good standing typically receive tuition and stipend, with mandatory health-services fee and student insurance covered for first five years. Confirm which offer terms apply; no stipend amount established.

timeline.interviews: Selected PhD candidates invited for interview/department visit in February or March (undated policy).
